facts.text: Grand Hyatt Mumbai is set across 12 acres of landscaped gardens in Santacruz.
facts.excerpt: Set across 12 acres of lush, landscaped gardens, Grand Hyatt Mumbai is an urban oasis in Santacruz

facts.text: The hotel is minutes from the airport.
facts.excerpt: an urban oasis in Santacruz, just minutes from the airport

facts.text: Every serviced apartment at Grand Hyatt Mumbai Residences has access to a private swimming pool area and its own entry and lobby.
facts.excerpt: has access to a private swimming pool area, exclusive entry, lobby, parking, security, and customized dining and laundry packages for resident guests

facts.text: Guestrooms have a marble bathroom.
facts.excerpt: featuring a plush king bed, elegant marble bathroom, and refined interiors designed for effortless relaxation

facts.text: The Verandah Suite has an expansive private verandah with views of the hotel's green landscapes and the Mumbai skyline.
facts.excerpt: Take in sweeping views of the hotel's green landscapes and the Mumbai skyline from your expansive private verandah.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite includes butler service.
facts.excerpt: Thoughtful butler service completes an exceptional luxury experience.

facts.text: The serviced apartments have fully equipped kitchens for short and extended stays.
facts.excerpt: a fully equipped contemporary kitchen designed for both short and extended stays

facts.text: An outdoor pool and a children's pool are on the banquet level.
facts.excerpt: Located on the banquet level, our alluring outdoor pool and children

facts.text: The pool has a dedicated poolside bar.
facts.excerpt: Choose from our refreshing cocktails and mocktails at the dedicated poolside bar

facts.text: Club Oasis spa on the banquet level offers spa treatments.
facts.excerpt: Experience the wonders of a well-rested body and mind with our blissful treatment options at the banquet-level Club Oasis, designed to rejuvenate you.

facts.text: The Club Oasis Fitness Centre has a fully equipped gym and personal trainers.
facts.excerpt: featuring a fully equipped gymnasium, personal trainers, and innovative exercise programs

facts.text: The Grand Club lounge is accessible to Club room and suite guests.
facts.excerpt: Experience opulence at the private and exclusive Grand Club lounge, accessible to Club room and suite guests.

facts.text: The Grand Club offers private breakfast, high tea and cocktail hours.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in a private breakfast, high-tea, cocktail hours, or boardroom facilities.

facts.text: Children under 16 and pets are not allowed in the Grand Club.
facts.excerpt: Kids below 16 years and pets are strictly not allowed.

facts.text: The Magic Table is a dinner experience created by mentalists Thommy Ten and Amelie van Tass, with 3D projections, illusion and a five-course dinner.
facts.excerpt: The Magic Table unfolds through immersive 3D projections, illusion and unexpected interactions, paired with a specially curated 5-course dinner.

facts.text: China House has served Sichuan cuisine in Mumbai for over two decades.
facts.excerpt: For over two decades, China House has defined authentic Sichuan dining in Mumbai

facts.text: Dogs and cats are welcome with at least three days' notice before arrival.
facts.excerpt: whether dogs or cats! Just let us know at least three days before you arrive if your pet will be joining you.

facts.text: The Nita Mukesh Ambani Cultural Centre and Jio World Drive are in nearby BKC.
facts.excerpt: Right in BKC, discover inspiring performances at the Nita Mukesh Ambani Cultural Centre (NMACC) and indulge in shopping and dining at Jio World Drive.

facts.text: A taxi to the international airport's Terminal 2 takes about 15 to 25 minutes, depending on traffic.
facts.excerpt: Travel Time: 15–25 minutes (subject to traffic).

facts.excerpt: LOOKS Salon at Grand Hyatt Mumbai offers a premium salon experience with expert hair, beauty, nail, and grooming services

facts.excerpt: Wake up to calming views of the hotel's lush courtyard
